# Synthetic catalog seeds

The two native SDS seed records contain a fitted synthetic product and its index
reference. The numerical coefficients are fixed regression input, not a claim about
a real object. Keeping those two records preserves the fitted binary layout and
coefficient bytes independently of the host publication code. Recomputing a fit
belongs to the propagator's numerical validation, outside these host export tests.

`generateCatalogHistory` expands the seeds into four editions in temporary test
directories. Eight pinned SHA-256 digests check that generated bytes equal the
original history corpus. The 2 MB expanded copies are not stored in the repository.
Daily editions change identifiers and metadata; they do not refit the products.
